targets.title: Cytochrome c CxxCH Heme Attachment Site
targets.hint_role: Two cysteine thiols form covalent thioether bonds to porphyrin vinyl groups while histidine serves as axial Fe ligand.
targets.hint_detail: Defining bioinorganic signature of electron-transport hemoproteins in mitochondrial and bacterial respiratory chains.
targets.context_requirement: Matured by cytochrome c heme lyase / Ccm system in the periplasm or mitochondrial intermembrane space.
targets.exemplar_source: UniProt:P07143 (Yeast Mitochondrial Cytochrome c1 101-105); PDB:3CX5; PROSITE:PS51007

reference_provenance.notes: Yeast mitochondrial Cytochrome c1 CXXCH heme site.

targets.title: Apoptotic Executioner Protease Cleavage Site
targets.hint_role: Canonical P4-P1' recognition sequence cleaved after the second acidic residue in PARP-1 during apoptosis.
targets.hint_detail: Strictly requires aspartate at both P4 and P1 positions followed by a small unbranched P1' residue.
targets.context_requirement: Requires an exposed solvent-accessible loop between the N-terminal DNA-binding and C-terminal catalytic domains.

reference_provenance.notes: Human PARP1 Caspase-3/7 cleavage site (cleaved after Asp214).

targets.title: SCF-Beta-TrCP Phosphodegron N-Core
targets.hint_role: Phosphorylation by IKK kinase recruits the cullin-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase to trigger NF-kappa-B activation.
targets.hint_detail: First five residues of the human I-kappa-B-alpha destruction box bound to the SCF-beta-TrCP WD40 receptor in PDB:9T9W.
targets.context_requirement: Requires dual serine phosphorylation within the disordered N-terminal tail (31-35) of I-kappa-B-alpha.

reference_provenance.notes: Human NFKBIA / I-kappa-B-alpha beta-TrCP phosphodegron (PDB:9T9W entity 2 directly deposits phosphorylated I-kappa-B-alpha DRHDSGLDSMKD).

targets.title: ER Luminal C-Terminal Retention Signal
targets.hint_role: Recognized in the cis-Golgi by seven-transmembrane retrieval receptors to return escaped ER chaperones.
targets.hint_detail: Extreme C-terminal tetrapeptide preceded by an acidic glutamate in human ER Hsp70 chaperone BiP.
targets.context_requirement: Must reside at the extreme C-terminus (-COOH free) of soluble ER luminal proteins (BiP/HSPA5, PDI).

reference_provenance.notes: Human HSPA5/BiP extreme C-terminal ER retention signal; PDB:6I6H entity 2 is synthetic bound AEKDEL peptide.

targets.title: Orphanin FQ / Nociceptin Receptor Agonist
targets.hint_role: Extreme N-terminal 'message' pentapeptide activating the NOP opioid-related GPCR while excluding classical mu/delta subtypes.
targets.hint_detail: Replaces the N-terminal phenolic Tyr1 of enkephalins with an unhydroxylated Phe1, a flexible achiral dipeptide spacer, Phe4, and Thr5.
targets.context_requirement: Requires a free N-terminal alpha-amino group on Phe1 to form a salt bridge with Asp130 in the NOP receptor pocket.

targets.title: Fibronectin III-10 Integrin-Binding Loop
targets.hint_role: Extracellular matrix cell-attachment loop recognized by alpha5-beta1 and alphaV-beta3 integrins.
targets.hint_detail: Flanks the central cationic-glycine-anionic tripeptide with an N-terminal Gly and C-terminal polar Ser.
targets.context_requirement: Presented at the apex of the 10th fibronectin type III beta-hairpin loop; Asp coordinates the MIDAS Mg2+ ion.

reference_provenance.notes: Human Fibronectin FN1 canonical coordinates 1614-1618 (older mature fragment numbering 1492-1496).

targets.title: KRAS4B C-Terminal CAAX Prenylation Tail
targets.hint_role: Farnesyltransferase attaches a C15 isoprenoid lipid to the fourth-from-last thiol before tripeptide proteolysis.
targets.hint_detail: Preceded by a polybasic lysine track; final methionine residue directs high-affinity farnesylation.
targets.context_requirement: Strictly requires extreme C-terminal positioning; -VIM is cleaved by Rce1 and alpha-carboxyl-methylated by ICMT.

reference_provenance.notes: Human KRAS Isoform 2B polybasic C-terminal CaaX farnesylation box; RCSB SIFTS maps 1D8D entity 3 to base P01116.

targets.hint_role: Cytosolic extreme C-terminal retrieval signal on ER-resident membrane proteins recognized by alpha/beta'-COP WD40 propellers.
targets.hint_detail: Alternating cationic primary amines at positions -5 and -3 from the C-terminus pair with an acidic side chain, polar hydroxyl, and terminal carboxylate.
targets.context_requirement: Canonical extreme C-terminal K-X-K-X-X retrieval signal (lysines at positions -5 and -3; co-crystallized AKEKSD peptide in PDB:4J77 entity 1).

reference_provenance.notes: Human OST48/DDOST extreme C-terminal -KxKxx COPI retrieval signal (452-456); PDB:4J77 entity 1 is co-crystallized Wbp1 C-terminal peptide AKEKSD.

targets.title: Clathrin AP-2 Mu2 Tyrosine Sorting Signal
targets.hint_role: Binds the medium subunit of heterotetrameric vesicle adaptor complexes for rapid endocytosis from the plasma membrane.
targets.hint_detail: Requires an unphosphorylated N-terminal phenolic residue and a bulky hydrophobic side chain three positions downstream.
targets.context_requirement: Must be in an extended conformation within a cytosolic receptor tail; Tyr phosphorylation blocks AP-2 binding.
targets.exemplar_source: UniProt:P19814 (Rat TGN38 Cytoplasmic Tail 350-354); PDB:1BXX; ELM:TRG_ENDOCYTIC_1

reference_provenance.notes: Rat TGN38 tyrosine-based AP2 internalization motif; PDB:1BXX entity 2 is synthetic DYQRLN peptide.
